answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each wallet registers against a verified legal entity that posts a cash escrow covering all its wallets. A successful sybil report triggers a vote; if upheld, the operator's escrow pays the reporter and a voyage-tracking audit fee, and every wallet under that operator is frozen pending re-verification at the wharf registry. The attacker's real cost is capital tied up per entity plus forfeiture on any single bad cluster, so scaling identities multiplies locked collateral until the willow-wide audit clears them.
